bgmMeta.prompt:
Instrumental only. No vocals, no lyrics, no choir singing words, no spoken voice.
30-second seamless VERSUS fighting-game stage loop for 「白门雀台」 — the music of an active duel, not a victory parade or adventure overworld.
Stage description (color the arrangement, do NOT make it cheerful): 左右两侧为较低的青砖校场地面，中央升起厚实的石砖铜雀台基座（实体高台，与左右地面相连，落差约一人高），中央基座上方还有一层由朱红梁柱支撑的木制阁楼平台。背景为白门楼门洞与黄昏冷月。所有战斗地形侧视同层，无深渊。
Instrumentation palette: hybrid orchestra + dark electronic pulse: low strings, muted brass, tight combat drums.
Genre: dark cinematic fighter / arena combat underscore (Street Fighter / Tekken / Guilty Gear vibe: pressure, grit, immersion).
Harmony: prefer minor / modal / tense intervals; sustained low drones under a driving mid-tempo groove.
Melody: short motif or rhythmic hook only — no catchy cheerful lead, no playful whistle, no bright pop earworm.
Tempo around 118 BPM. Heavy and focused; intro locks in within 1–2 bars; end on a loop-friendly downbeat with no fade-out cliff.
Mood keywords: tense, confrontational, immersive, weighty, determined.
Hard avoid: upbeat pop, happy major fanfare, cute chiptune bounce, festival EDM, comedy/cartoon scoring, soft lo-fi chill, triumphant victory theme, long ambient silence.
Production: 44.1kHz stereo, game-ready mid-forward mix, controlled low end, moderate compression, no dead air at start or end.
